runs.name: Marubeni Corporation
runs.entry: Price **¥4,702** (TSE 8002 close 2026-10-09; Tokyo shut 2026-10-12) and ADS **$29.74** (close 2026-10-12; USD/JPY 158.06), aggregator, flagged; **1 ADS = 1 share** on three depositary F-6 POS amendments (Citibank 0001193805-26-000735, 2026-06-02; JPMorgan 0001193805-26-000925, 2026-07-07; Deutsche Bank 0001104659-26-082191, 2026-07-09); no share split in the company's documents (issued 1,660,758,361 at both 2026-03-31 and 2026-06-30), a depositary change only. Shares **1,621,224,186** (issued less 33,979,475 treasury at 2026-06-30, Q1 FY2026 release of 2026-08-03, less 5,554,700 bought to 2026-09-30 per the notice of 2026-10-01) = cap **¥7,623bn** ($48.2bn); sovereign **4.136%** (JGB 30Y, Ministry of Finance jgbcme.csv, 2026-10-08). Not an SEC registrant: `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned nothing; every figure by hand from the company's audited English IFRS statements FY2016 to FY2025 (FY2025 posted 2026-06-12), the Integrated Report 2026, the FY2025 and Q1 FY2026 results, the FY2025 IR presentation and timely disclosures; operating cash FY2025 ¥535,398M cross-checked against the Integrated Report and the release; net debt ¥1,858.7bn cross-checked. Japanese yuho and convocation notice not read. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the company's annual documents, as the overnight brief directs. **Q1 IN** on the deciding part: no part carries half of five-year segment profit (segment net profit is the only part measure filed, a CONVENTION of the run), so the largest decides, Metals & Mineral Resources at 32.6% (¥811bn of ¥2,486bn, FY2021 to FY2025; next part 12.7%), mostly minority stakes in partner-run copper, iron-ore and coking-coal mines, understood by cost position (M2006-004, M2009-059; L1993-023, M2016-025). The analyst set down that a stricter reader closes Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE) on M2020-035. **Q2 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: the low-cost castle (L2000-017, M1997-010) shown tenuous (M2000-019): the part lost money in both recent troughs (Energy & Metals ¥(142.4)bn FY2015, Metals ¥(5.7)bn FY2019; M2009-059, L1997-021); Antofagasta's 2025 report puts Centinela at $0.75/lb after gold credits but $2.27/lb before them, Antucoya at $2.82/lb; the company claims top-quartile cost only after the 2027 Centinela expansion; durability a price forecast no one can make (M2011-047, L1993-023); TOO HARD not OUT under M2006-013. Re-look: the first fiscal year after the Centinela expansion (stated for 2027) in which Marubeni's equity copper volume or the copper price falls. Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (operating plus investing cash, less lease principal and hybrid distributions) FY2021-25 averaged ¥274bn equity, ¥303bn all-equity, against net profit ¥497bn (equity-method profit ¥338bn against ¥221bn of dividends received, FY2025); base the ten-year FY2016-25 average ¥275.5bn all-equity under (a), both first window years aberrational (a ¥341.5bn inventory build, a ¥330.1bn subsidiary sale); growth 4.05%; claims net debt ¥2,078.2bn plus minorities ¥150.3bn (deducting minorities like debt a CONVENTION of the run). Range **¥2,734 to ¥4,391 all-equity central ($17.30 to $27.78 per ADS)** against ¥4,702; organic pair ¥2,935 to ¥6,309; literal window ¥3,141 to ¥4,963; equity-only ¥3,668 to ¥4,975; 3.93% at the price on the central growth case, so Q7 would have closed OUT on the floor. Fair price beneath the stop **¥596 all-equity ($3.77)**, ¥1,677 equity-only ($10.61); not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Balance sheets: net debt to equity 2.10 to 0.43, equity tripled, much of it translation (FY2025 comprehensive income ¥968bn against net profit ¥544bn); equity-method investments 33% of assets. Recorded after the stop, not weighed: a 2014 US guilty plea under the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act ($88M fine, Indonesian power project, DOJ citing refusal to cooperate; read from search-result text, justice.gov refused the fetch; a 2012 Nigeria matter recalled, not verified, not used), which any run reaching Q5 must answer (M2013-088); Sugar Group US$250M Indonesian judgment with no provision, a 2022 favourable ruling revoked 2026-01-19 (auditor's key audit matter); the company's own ROIC 7% non-resources and 6% 'others' on most of ¥6.2tn invested; buybacks name no price, September 2026 at an average ¥5,066, above the computed range. Competitors: the company names none by name; none of the trading houses files with the SEC; from their own reports Marubeni's ROE averaged below ITOCHU's FY2015-25 and went negative in FY2019 (ITOCHU no loss year); Mitsui FY2021-24 only; Mitsubishi's site refused (403), Sumitomo not fetched. Contamination declared by the analyst: names only of the ITOCY, MITSY and MTSUY run files and the MTSUY addendum in a directory listing, and the ITOCY commit subject 'OUT at Q7 on the floor'; none opened; the framework's own 'MITSY regression run' read as governing text. Brief error recorded: the dispatcher's brief named JPMorgan for the 2026-06-02 F-6 POS, whose depositary is Citibank. Commits 5affbc29 to 09d5f1d9. Citations: the analyst's check 37 distinct ids present, no E-ids; the dispatcher's adjacency script 19 adjacent fragments, 0 slips (two framework phrases quoted in the analyst's 'unclear' section flagged by its own script, not beside an id as a row's words). Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** this is the third trading house of the day to put the commodity question and the second to stop on it (MTSUY at Q1, MARUY at Q2; ITOCY passed both on BHP's lowest-cost iron ore). The analyst's gaps: (1) the parts threshold names operating profit, which a trading house does not file by segment, and the segments were reorganised five years running; (2) no rule for when 'the largest part' at 32.6% is too small to stand for the whole, against M2023-031 kept OPEN; (3) no test for a producer low-cost only through by-product credits, or whose cost leadership is tied to an unfinished expansion (where cost position is read, before or after by-products, over which span); (4) Q7's all-equity basis is silent on non-controlling interests.
runs.narr: Q2 TOO HARD (NATURE): a Japanese trading house in ten segments where none has half the profit, so Metals & Mineral Resources decides at 32.6%, mostly partner-run copper, iron-ore and coal stakes; Q1 IN by cost position, but the low-cost castle is tenuous: losses in both recent troughs, Centinela low-cost only after gold credits ($0.75/lb against $2.27/lb before them), top-quartile only after a 2027 expansion. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range ¥2,734 to ¥4,391 all-equity at the 4.136% JGB against ¥4,702 (3.9% at the price), fair ¥596 all-equity (¥1,677 equity-only), not armed. After the stop: a 2014 US bribery guilty plea, an unprovisioned US$250M Sugar Group judgment, buybacks above the range.
